def find_separator_lines(grid):
    """Find rows and columns that are completely filled with the same value"""
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows > 0 else 0
    
    sep_rows = []
    for i in range(rows):
        if len(set(grid[i])) == 1:
            sep_rows.append(i)
    
    sep_cols = []
    for j in range(cols):
        col_vals = [grid[i][j] for i in range(rows)]
        if len(set(col_vals)) == 1:
            sep_cols.append(j)
    
    return sep_rows, sep_cols
